data.statement: Psalm 110 addresses a figure who is declared a priest forever after the order of Melchizedek.
data.interpretive_divergence: Identification of the addressed figure is contested between traditions.

provenance.label: Finding
provenance.detail: The psalm ascribes a perpetual, non-Levitical priesthood to its addressee.

provenance.label: Claims used
provenance.detail: Melchizedek priesthood order; royal enthronement language.

provenance.label: Supporting evidence
provenance.detail: Second Temple reception of Psalm 110 in Qumran and later literature.

provenance.label: Interpretations
provenance.detail: Royal, messianic and christological readings are attributed separately.

provenance.label: Counterviews
provenance.detail: Purely royal-court readings of the psalm.
